scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w terse-sdk && npm run build -w terse-cli
scripts.link:cli: npm run build:packages && npm link --workspace terse-cli
scripts.link:packages: npm run build:packages && npm link --workspace terse-sdk && npm link --workspace terse-cli
scripts.python:refresh-types: npm run sync:shared && npm run generate:pydantic
scripts.python:check: npm run python:refresh-types && ./.venv/bin/ruff check packages/terse-python-cli/src packages/terse-python-cli/tests packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ruff format --check packages/terse-python-cli/src packages/terse-python-cli/tests packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ty check packages/terse-python-cli/src packages/terse-python-sdk/src && npm run python:test
scripts.python:build: npm run python:refresh-types && uv build --package terse-cli && uv build --package terse-sdk
scripts.python:dist:check: npm run python:build && uvx twine check dist/terse_cli-* dist/terse_sdk-*
